title: Phase 9 harness artifacts uncommitted at candidate tag time in all canonical skills
description: In all three canonical skills (run.skill.md, spec.skill.md, fix_signal.skill.md), Phase 7 commits all working-tree changes. Phase 9 (Version and Tag) subsequently writes additional harness artifacts: the run file is re-written with candidate_tag set, the signal catalogue entry status is updated to 'candidate', and the signal index is updated. These files are loose (uncommitted) when the candidate tag is created, meaning the tag does not point at a commit containing the complete run artifact set. This affects every run that reaches Phase 9 across all three skills.
proposed_resolution: Add a Phase 9b to all three canonical skills that stages and commits all post-Phase-7 harness artifact writes before creating the candidate tag. The commit should use git_commit with kind='run'. The candidate tag must always be created after Phase 9b so it points at the commit containing the full run artifact set. Reasoning-review signals (Phase 5a/5b) must also land in a commit before the candidate tag if those phases are moved to after Phase 9.
